To Captain Mr Butcher, Greetings.

I trust the harbour at Hastings has welcomed you warmly and that your vessel is loading smoothly.

Once you return the grant along with the agreed return sum (£36,875.00), we will formally and successfully conclude our trade transaction.

Thank you for your prompt cooperation, and I wish you fair winds and a safe voyage back to Glasgow.

In Service,

Michael Blackwood
Trade Minister of Sussex
